## How it works

Every formula returns a `Traced<T>`, and a trace looks like `{ value, trace }` in code.

![A box labelled Book a card](images/01/diagram.svg)

```ts
// TODO in code is fine, and so are # lines and braces.
# not a heading
const traced = { value: 3, trace: null };
```
